description: Scrape your INDmoney US stock portfolio, holdings, and full trade history from the terminal.
auth_description: INDmoney uses the "token" cookie (a JWT) from the browser session as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Run `auth login --chrome` to extract the token cookie from your logged-in Chrome/ego-browser session. The token expires every ~9 hours; re-run auth login to refresh. You can also set INDMONEY_TOKEN manually by extracting the cookie value.

novel_features.name: Portfolio Summary with Per-Stock P&L
novel_features.description: See your total invested value, current value, overall P&L, and day change across all US stock holdings.

novel_features.name: Holdings Detail
novel_features.description: List every stock you hold with quantity, avg price, current value, unrealised gains, and day P&L.

novel_features.name: Full Order History
novel_features.description: Every buy and sell order you have placed, with transaction type, quantity, avg price, and status.

novel_features.name: Sync to Local SQLite
novel_features.description: Download all portfolio data and order history into a local SQLite database for offline analysis.

novel_features.name: Market Indices Snapshot
novel_features.description: Live prices for Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow Jones, and other US indices with market status.
